name: replica-read-your-writes
description: Phase 13 vertical slice 4 (model only): write through the primary, read back through a lagging read replica. The replica is the model's abstraction of asynchronous streaming replication (commits replayed in commit order, unbounded lag); no PostgreSQL replication was run.

actors.name: A
actors.program:
update profiles where @id == 1 set @name = "new"
let p = replica select profiles where @id == 1
return p.name
